quality.review_scope: Independent complete three-page main scientific and apparatus audit of accepted R2 passed. Cited full references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Complete supplied three-page main, Figures 1–4, Table 1 and all 23 references. SI and cited full sources unreviewed.

Silica precursor amounts are given as a gel molar composition, not absolute charges. Starting CTAB/NaOH solution concentrations, mixing order, gel temperature, autoclave capacity, wash volumes and 60 °C drying duration are unreported.

Numerical vacuum, cooling duration, impregnation addition rate and room-temperature drying time are unreported. Three milliliters is the AgNO3/ethanol solution charge, not a separately quantified ethanol volume.
Only part of AS received the 300 °C treatment; the amount, heating ramp and atmosphere are not given. The 500 °C follow-up duration, ramp, atmosphere and exact specimen fraction are unknown.

PS, AS and AST are source-labelled successive states, not independently reproduced batches. Cross-record lineage links retain their source scope without copying parent products or inventing repeated preparations.

Cubic MCM-48 order and [110] directions refer to mesoporous structure. Ag array width, gap and line spacing are not atomic Ag unit-cell parameters. No measured atomic or finite-particle coordinates are supplied.

The silver-ion/nitrate complex in AS is tentative, not a resolved molecular structure. The source does not quantify the Ag content, size distribution, array fraction or larger-particle dimensions after 500 °C.
No optical, electronic, catalytic or adsorption-capacity application experiment is supplied beyond the reported nitrogen pore characterization. Proposed assembly forces remain interpretation.
Independent source comparison passed; molecular/particle/reference-cell presentation remains pending.
